ui.title: Magic Workshop
ui.intro: Choose a style and see what kind of magical portrait your pet could get.

styles.name: Storybook
styles.desc: A soft, pastel storybook world with sparkling eyes and a gentle watercolor feel – as if your little one were the star of a sweet story.

styles.name: Digital 3D Clay
styles.desc: Your little one as a cute, hand-sculpted 3D clay figure, in soft studio light and a charming pastel mini world – with gentle, playful features.

styles.name: Comic Book Hero
styles.desc: Your little one becomes a classic comic-book superhero – complete with their very own purple-and-gold cape and paw-print medallion, set against a striking pop-art background in vivid colors.

styles.name: Pixel Art
styles.desc: Your little one sets off on an adventure as the hero of a classic video game – with true retro pixel charm, beneath a crescent moon and a starry night sky.

styles.name: Mexican Flower Fiesta
styles.desc: A colorful Mexican fiesta mood: your little one shines in a flower crown, surrounded by glowing candlelight and festive paper banners.

styles.name: Ukiyo-e
styles.desc: A timeless Japanese woodblock-print mood: your little one becomes the star of a classic Japanese artwork, in soft tones and embraced by stylized waves.

styles.name: Christmas
styles.desc: A warm Christmas scene by the fireplace with lights and gifts. Your pet gets a Santa hat and a knitted scarf.

styles.name: Golden Icon Portrait
styles.desc: A noble, museum-worthy masterpiece: your little one shines in a richly ornate golden frame, before a glowing gold-leaf background – as if painted by an old master.

styles.name: Fairy-Tale Witch
styles.desc: A magical witchy mood with a pointed hat, a glowing crystal ball and candlelight – as if your little one had stepped straight out of a fairy-tale world of magic.

styles.name: Mandala Ink Drawing
styles.desc: A finely detailed black-and-white mandala drawing: your little one’s shape is filled with magical floral and geometric patterns. You can print it out and even color it in yourself!

styles.name: Viking Warrior
styles.desc: Your pet as a brave Viking warrior: a fur cloak, an iron helmet, a fjord, a longship and the northern lights.

styles.name: Steampunk
styles.desc: The world of retro-futurism: brass aviator goggles, a geared harness, a steamy workshop and an airship at sunset.

styles.name: Tarot Card
styles.desc: Your pet as the main figure of an ornate, gold-framed tarot card, in a starry, moonlit landscape.
